responsibility: Declares lightweight utility classes for working with TyTy nodes. TyVar is the indirection handle used to refer to context-managed types and synthesize inference variables or cloned references, while TyWithLocation couples a type with a source location so unification, coercion, and cast routines can report precise diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Declares the TyVar and TyWithLocation utility wrapper types for this stem; the .cc file implements their context-backed lookup, inference-variable creation, and cloning/location-construction behavior.
